known_cutoff_publicity_caveats: Regular full-document managed agentic benchmark with high reasoning; no summaries or web search.

Meta does not report a training-data or knowledge cutoff in the announcement, model card or developer model documentation checked 2026-10-12. Eligibility remains qualified; release date is provenance, not a cutoff proxy.

Muse Wonder is a public preview available through the Meta Model API in Standard mode only. Muse Wonder Full is subscription-only in Muse Code and is a different model, unavailable through the Model API.
Gateway model meta/muse-wonder-1.0 is hard routed only to Meta. It is not an immutable dated snapshot; retain live served identity and routing metadata.
The live Gateway catalog reports a 1048576-token context window and maximum output. Retain the regular benchmark managed-runtime 128000 output cap.

Meta supports only automatic tool choice on Responses API. High reasoning is explicitly selected to match the regular benchmark condition; the provider's max reasoning results are a different configuration.
Standard pricing is USD 4.00/M input, 20.00/M output and 0.20/M cached input. Standard-mode content is not used to train Meta models; no contributor mode is available for pay-as-you-go Muse Wonder.
